title: Keep filed chat index references valid after repository relocation

costar.context: The operating-tree checker fails because four indexed filed event files reference a previous checkout path, although the same session files exist here.
costar.objective: Repair the existing references and make repository-local index paths portable without changing external transcript offsets or filed chats.
costar.style: A small path-resolution change with a regression test and whole-tree proof.
costar.response: The checker resolves relative index entries against the repository root and the existing entries use relative paths.

concerns: Index offsets belong to sources and must not be changed or transferred to unrelated Cursor transcripts.
Cursor sync identifies external transcripts using resolved absolute paths; the existing four entries name filed event files, not Cursor transcript inputs.
Changing the current working directory must not change how relative index paths are resolved.
Missing external absolute sources must still be reported by the checker.
context: Existing session files and byte index metadata are retained; only the paths to the four filed files are made relative to the repository.
current_state: The checker calls Path(source).is_file and the four entries contain a stale absolute checkout prefix.
target_design: The checker interprets relative references against ROOT, preserves absolute source paths, and still rejects missing sources.
changes: Add root-relative source resolution to the checker and rekey the four existing entries without modifying metadata.
Test resolution from another working directory, missing paths and absolute paths, then run the entire operating-tree checker.
boundaries: Do not alter or refile chat events, messages, tools, seen hashes, offsets or session metadata.
Do not run a transcript sync as a substitute for relocating the filed-file references.

verification.name: path-resolution-regression
verification.proves: Relative and absolute references are resolved correctly independent of working directory and missing files remain missing.

verification.name: whole-tree
verification.proves: The complete operating tree including all filed chat lines and plans validates with the repaired index.
verification.result: Exit 0: 6 modules, 605 lines, 42 documents, 169 events, 64 messages, 328 tools, 44 journal entries.
